I couldn't confirm it in the code. A search of this repo finds no `PAYMENTS_LIVE`, no gateway code, and no fake or mock payment implementation. The only env vars it reads are `DATABASE_URL` and `EXPORT_BUCKET`. The gateway switch must live in another service, a deploy config, or a branch I don't have. I marked the memory as user-reported and unverified for that reason.

If you tell me where the gateway selection lives, I can make it fail loudly instead of falling back silently. For example, it could refuse to start in production without an explicit setting, or log a warning when the fake gateway is active.
